script_text: Uranus meets Pluto this week, Aquarius — your Air nature is about to crack open. Sun trines Jupiter at two degrees Aquarius boosting your income and career standing from Monday. But Mars squares Uranus on Tuesday, so hold back on all impulsive financial moves. Wednesday shifts everything as the Moon enters your tenth House, activating the Sun-Jupiter trine and supercharging your professional visibility. By Thursday Mercury goes retrograde, asking you to carefully review important contracts and communications. Saturday's Full Moon hits your seventh House of partnerships, vulnerability here opens real love doors. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your fifth House in Pisces, igniting creative romance. Monday is your weakest day because Mars squares your ruling planet Uranus, creating dangerous financial volatility. Guard your resources early in the week, then let Wednesday's creative energy carry your career and love forward. Follow for daily updates.
